name: LinuxCNC plasma
description: LinuxCNC-style plasma in millimetres. Absolute moves, cutter compensation and tool length cancelled, path blend G64 P0.05. Torch on is M3 S1 and torch off is M5. The pierce delay is the dwell already on the path (G4 P in seconds). Arcs use IJK and helices are written as lines. thc.on is emitted on the first feed move after process on and the pierce dwell; thc.off is emitted before process off. Both lists are empty until that controller's torch-height codes are filled in. process_cycle is per_cut: every process, including spindle, turns off before a rapid and on again before the next feed. A pierce dwell is written only when the IR has one at that cut. No rotary axis.
